purpose: Improve the useful retrieval baseline while attributing gains to representation, retrieval or readout; do not repeat the failed weak reliability-weight formula.

development.scope: All R1 benchmarks are historically viewed; split only separates within-round choice from retest.

representations.construction: Unit-norm concatenation of sqrt(w)*CLIP and sqrt(1-w)*DINO; single-encoder endpoint models stay single-encoder.

anchor_refine.update: Re-retrieve with the current prototype, blend each new retrieved mean with the original support prototype, not with an unanchored drifting prototype.

kernel_residual.score: Convex blend of support cosine and log-mean-exp query-to-retrieved-image cosine / beta; each query independent.

retrieval_ridge.readout: Centered closed-form ridge over the five augmented class prototypes; gallery labels unavailable.

selection: For each shot choose the strongest simple control and strongest candidate using equal-cell macro accuracy on development only, including representation choice. Save all candidates, selected configs and code SHA256 before any retest/external scores. No further adaptive method families after freeze.

new_e12_validation.query_split: Official CUB test; existing deterministic EuroSAT test split. No E12 scores previously used; datasets may have been used by other local projects.
new_e12_validation.gallery: CUB official train all; EuroSAT deterministic 500 train images per class, with sampling labels available to dataset construction only.

gates.practical_upgrade: Against R1 frozen DINO uniform profile, >=0.5pp macro gain with positive paired CI, shared-class cells lose no more than 0.5pp, stress cells lose no more than 1pp; separately assess E12-new-dataset validation.
gates.method_increment: Against strongest newly tuned control, >=1pp macro gain with positive paired CI and consistent direction across both new same-domain datasets.
gates.fallback: Keep the strongest verified simple control when added mechanisms fail. Domain-specific positive evidence is recorded without converting it into universal superiority.

evidence: RGB source identity and gallery exclusion
paired episode CI and class-level sensitivity
